  let out;

      'node',
      ['scripts/run-dollhouse-skill-audit.mjs', '-r', 'TEMPORAL_CUSTODIAN', '--no-orchestrator', '--strict-provenance', '--format', 'json'],
      { input: JSON.stringify(payload), encoding: 'utf8' }
    );
  } catch (err) {
    out = err.stdout || err.stderr;
  }
  const parsed = JSON.parse(out);
  const f = parsed.specialist_findings?.[0];
  console.log(JSON.stringify({
    label,
    overall_decision: parsed.overall_decision,
    source_revision_verified: parsed.source_revision_verified,
    evidence_all_verified: parsed.evidence_manifest?.every(m => m.verified),

    specialist_status: f?.status,
    detected_infractions: parsed.detected_infractions,
    ledger_is_valid: f?.extensions?.temporal_audit?.ledger_audit?.is_valid,
    ledger_baseline_compared: f?.extensions?.temporal_audit?.ledger_audit?.baseline_compared,
    temporal_audit_verdict: f?.extensions?.temporal_audit?.verdict,
    journey_verdict: f?.extensions?.journey_chronology?.verdict,
    veto_applied: f?.extensions?.journey_chronology?.veto_applied,
    veto_authority: f?.extensions?.journey_chronology?.veto_authority,
    evaluations: f?.extensions?.journey_chronology?.evaluations,
    violations: f?.extensions?.temporal_audit?.violations
  }, null, 2));
}
